༄༅/ /rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing la rnam par lta bar byed pa zhing mchog bgrod pa'i them skas zhes bya ba bzhugs/

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing la rnam par lta bar byed pa

zhing mchog bgrod pa'i them skas zhes bya ba bzhugs/ na mo gu ru we/ smon lam phul byung rlabs chen gyis bskrun ngo mtshar phul byung zhing khams su/ /rnam dag phul byung 'khor gyis yongs bskor spangs rtogs phul byung rab rdzogs pa/ bde gshegs phul byung mi 'khrugs rgyal por gus pa phul byung gis 'dud kyi/ /zhing mchog phul byung mngon par dga' bar thugs rje phul byung gis drongs shig /thabs shes rlung gi shing rtas nyer drangs te/ /spangs rtogs shar ri'i rtse nas mngon par 'phags/ /'gro blo'i khams kyi mun pa gtan sel ba/ /thub dbang smra ba'i nyi mar gus phyag 'tshal/ /rab 'byams rgyal ba'i ye shes phung po kun/ /gcig tu bsdus kyang gang gi blo gros char/ /mtshon par mi nus mkhyen pa'i gter chen zhes/ /yongs grags brtan pa'i 'khor los rnam dpyod stsol/ /gang des zur phud dor nas bod yul 'dir/ /rgyal ba'i dam chos nyid kyi dgongs pa ltar/ /ji bzhin 'dzin phyir ngur smrig zlog gar gyis/ /rnam rol rje btsun tsong kha pa der 'dud/ /sngon tshe rgyal ba'i sras po mi 'khrugs pas/ /rnam dag smon lam mchog gis yongs bzung ba/ /mngon par dga' ba'i zhing gi bkod pa nyid/ /dam pas bskul phyir mdor bsdus bdag gis bri/ /de la 'dir bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pas sngon byang chub kyi spyod pa la slob pa'i tshe/ /thugs bskyed nas smon lam btab tshul/ zhing dag pa 'grub pa'i snod kyi bkod pa/ bcud kyi yon tan spyi dang*/ bye brag nyan thos kyi yon tan/ byang sems kyi yon tan/ zhing der skye ba'i rgyu gang yin rnams mdo las gsungs pa ltar gyi don bsdus nas bshad par bya'o/ /de yang rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pas sngon sangs rgyas spyan chen po zhes bya ba'i drung du rgyas sras kyi spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' mi 'khrugs pa zhes bya bar gyur nas thugs bskyed rlabs po ches smon lam btab ste/

zhing gi bkod pa yongs su bzung ba yin no/ /sangs rgyas de 'di nas shar phyogs logs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong tham pa na/ 'jig rten gyi khams mngon par dga' ba zhes bya ba'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa zhig yod pa der byon pa yin la/ de lta bu'i zhing de nyid da lta'i mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing dang rgyun gcig yin par mngon no/ /dam bcas te smon lam btab tshul ni/ mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing bkod kyi mdo las/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa ji ltar bcas pa 'di la bslab par 'tshal lo/ /zhes sogs dang*/ btsun pa bcom ldan 'das bdag deng g.yo ma mchis pa dang*/ sgyu ma mchis par/ dam pa'i tshig dang*/ gzhan du mi 'gyur ba'i tshig gis bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems bskyed par bgyi'o/ /zhes sogs kyis/ sems can thams cad la mi khro ba dang*/ gnod sems mi bya ba sogs nyon mongs pa kun dang ma 'dres pa'i sems kyis thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang ma bsgrubs na/ bdag 'tshang mi rgya ba sogs kyi dam bca' brtan pos smon lam mang du btab pa'i tshe/ de phyin chad skye ba thams cad du mtshan la mi 'khrugs pa zhes bya bar chags so/ /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i drung du thugs bskyed kyis/ /smon lam rgya mtsho rlabs chen btab pa'i mthus/ /zhing khams rgya mtsho rnam dag yongs bzung ba/ /rgyal sras rgya mtsho'i gtso bo mi 'khrugs pa/ /bskal bzang byang sems stong phrag dag gi nang*/ khyod dang mtshungs pa gcig kyang yod min zhing*/ /rab 'byams zhing du'ang rnyed par dkon no zhes/ /rgyas pa nyid kyis rab bsngags khyod min su/ /zhes bya ba ni thugs bskyed de smon lam ji ltar btab pa'i skabs so// //de ltar smon lam btab pa bzhin yongs su 'grub pa'i zhing ni mngon par dga' ba ste/ zhing de'i dbus su byang chub kyi shing rin po che sna bdun las grub pa/

'phang du ni dpag tshad 'bum dang*/ khor yug tu ni dpag tshad bzhi khri yod cing*/ chos kyi sgra 'byung ba sogs kyi yon tan dang ldan pa'i drung du mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de ni/ sa gzhi khyon yangs shing rgya che ba/ lag mthil ltar mnyam pa/ gos ka tsa lin di ka ltar reg na bde ba/ kha dog gser bzang po ltar gsal zhing*/ lha'i nor bu rin po ches spras pa/ thams cad du pad+ma gser gyi mdog can bye ba khrag khris legs par brgyan pa/ me tog man+da ra ba dang*/ man+da ra ba chen po dag mngon par bkra ba/ sdong dum dang tsher ma dang*/ gyo mo dang*/ rdo phal pa dang*/ ri nag po med cing*/ sa gzhi la rkang pa bzhag pa na/ nem zhes byed cing dma' bar 'gyur la/ rkang pa yar bteg pa na par zhes byed cing mtho bar 'gyur ba'i sa gzhi 'jam zhing mnyen pa la sogs pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'o/ /rnam dag smon lam bye ba'i rgyu tshogs las/ /rnam par 'khrungs pa yongs su dag pa'i zhing*/ /rnam kun bkod pa rab rdzogs mngon dga' nyid/ /rnam mang zhing mchog gzhan las khyad par 'phags/ /rin chen byang chub shing gis rab mdzes shing*/ /gser ltar dag sogs yon tan kun nas rdzogs/ /sdong dum tsher ma sogs ky-i skyon bral ba/ /shin tu rnam dag zhing gi mchog khyaud bsngags/ /zhes bya ba ni/ snod kyi yon tan gyi khyad par brjod pa'i skabs so// //bcud kyi yon tan ni/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na ngan song gsum dang*/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi rigs dang snyigs ma lnga sogs med cing*/ der skyes pa'i sems can kun kyang dge ba bcu'i lam la gnas pa sha stag go /de na sems can rnams la chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas nyid ma gtogs pa/ rje bo dang bran gyi bye brag gang yang med la/ yo byad rnams la chags pa'i bdag tu 'dzin pa yang med do/ /gzhan yang der sdug bsngal med pas rlung mkhris bad kan 'dus pa'i nad rnams med cing*/

mi rnams la kha dog mi legs pa dang*/ dri mi zhim pa yang med la/ 'dod chags sogs kyang shin tu chung ngo*/ /sems can de dag la phan tshun gsod cing bcing ba dang*/ rdeg pa sogs rnam pa thams cad du med la/ mu stegs can gyi rigs kyang med de/ /ljon shing rnams la rtag tu me tog dang 'bras bu chags shing*/ mi rnams kyi gos ni dpag bsam gyi shing las byung ba'i gos dri bzang po kha dog rnam pa lnga dang ldan pa/ gang 'dod pa des rang gi gos byed pa'o/ /zas ni rang gi ci lta bu 'dod pa de ltar mdun du rin po che'i snod kyi nang du 'byung zhing*/ kha dog dri ro ni lha'i zas bzhin no/ /zas zos kyang mi rnams la bshang ba dang*/ gci ba dang*/ mchil ma dang*/ snabs dag med do/ /mi de dag 'dod na/ der rin po che sna bdun gyi khri dang ldan pa'i khang pa brtsegs pa dag 'byung bar 'gyur zhing*/ khang brtsegs der rdzing bu dang*/ khri steng du shing bal gyi stan dag gi kyang ji ltar 'byung ba la rtse bar byed do/ /chu de dag kyang yan lag brgyad dang ldan la/ gal te de rnams kyang rang gi rjes su 'brang bar 'dod na'ang 'brang bar 'gyur la/ mi snang bar 'dod na yang mi snang bar 'gyur ro/ /rlung kha mnyam pa kho na ldan zhing rlung de las kyang dri shin tu zhim pa 'byung ngo*/ /de yang 'dod na ldang la mi 'dod na ni mi ldang ngo*/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing de'i bud med rnams ni/ mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba lha mo lta bu sha stag ste/ bud med kyi skyon thams cad dang bral ba kho na'o/ /de dag skyes pa dang lhan cig 'khrig pa'i lus sbyor ba med de/ gal te skyes pa zhig bud med gang la chags sems skyes na/ bud med de la yud tsam zhig bltas pas 'dod pa de zhi nas 'dod chags dang bral ba'i ting nge 'dzin thob ste/ de phyin chad 'dod chags kyi sems mi skye'o/ /gang la bltas pa'i bud med de yang sbrum mar 'gyur zhing*/

mngal gyi khye'u 'am bu mo 'chags pa des kyang lha'i bde ba ltar bde ba khyad par can myong zhing*/ zhag bdun lon pa'i tshe nas gser gyi khang pa nas 'byung ba ltar btsa' la/ mas kyang bsam gtan gnyis pa'i bde ba lta bu myong ngo*/ /bu btsas kyang mi gtsang ba dang dri mi zhim pa ye med do/ /gal te su zhig rgyan gang thogs par 'dod na/ dpag bsam gyi shing las de bzhin du 'byung ngo*/ /gzhan yang*/ de na nyon 'tshong dang*/ so nam byed pa dag med la/ rtse yang chos kyi dga' bas rtse ba ma gtogs/ nyon mongs pa can gyi rtse ba med do/ /shing dag las kyang sgra snyan pa ches yid du 'ong ba dag 'byung la/ rtag tu sangs rgyas kyi 'od kyis khyab pa ma gtogs/ nyi zla med cing mun pa yang med do/ /rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa de nyid gzhan du gshegs pa'i tshe/ zhabs sa gzhi gang du bzhag pa de dang der pad+ma gser gyi mdog can 'dab ma stong yod pa dag 'byung ngo*/ /pad+ma rnams ni mi de dag gis der gnas par 'dod na gnas la/ mi 'dod na ni/ nam mkha' la 'phags par 'gyur ro/ /zhing de'i mi rnams kyis lha rnams mthong la/ lhas kyang mi rnams mthong ngo*/ /de dag la lha mi'i khyad par ma gtogs/ mdzes pa dang yo byad la khyad par ci yang med do/ /der gser dang*/ dngul dang*/ be ḍūr+ya las grub pa'i rin po che'i them skas sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha'i gnas kyi bar sleb par btsugs pa der lha mi rnams yas man du 'gro bar byed la/ de'i tshe lhas mi la smon gyi/ mis lha la mi smon pa sogs kyi yon tan dang ldan no/ /ngan song la sogs skyon gyis ma gos shing*/ /zhing gi bkod pa'i yon tan kun rdzogs par/ /lha las kyang ni khyad par zhugs pa'am/ /'byor ba'i rtse dgas rtag rol e ma mtshar/ /smon lam stobs can srid zhi yongs kyi mgon/ /mgon po khyod kyis zhing gi 'byor pa kun/ /kun nas bsdus pas da lta'i zhing mchog 'di/ /

'di ltar skyon gyis gos pa yin nam snyam/ zhes bya ba ni zhing gi bcud kyi yon tan spyir bstan pa'i skabs so// //yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa'i nyan thos kyi dge 'dun rnam par dag pa ni grangs med cing*/ dpag tu med do/ /de yang sangs rgyas ma gtogs/ 'jig rten gyi rtsis mkhan sus kyang bgrang bar mi nus te/ gzhan du na dpag tu med pa zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro'o/ /rgyun du zhugs pa dang*/ lhan cig phyir 'ong ba sogs kyi ming tsam yod kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di'i rgyun tu zhugs pa sogs dang mi 'dra'o/ /des na nyan thos so skye bas kyang 'phags pa mang la/ dgra bcom pa de dag phal cher rnam par thar pa brgyad thob pa'o/ /de dag bsod snyoms la rgyu ba ni med de/ zas kyi dus la babs pa na/ lhung bzed duḥkha zas bzang po ji ltar 'dod pa dag 'byung zhing*/ de yang kham gnyis gsum tsam gyis chog par 'gyur ro/ /de na ltung ba bzhi mi 'byung bas/ sangs rgyas kyis kyang ltung ba bzhi dang ldan pa'i chos mi ston te/ thog ma nyid nas stong pa nyid dang ldan pa'i chos ston no/ /de dag dbang po rno ba sha stag ste/ rab tu byung ba'i skyon du bya ba de dag la med do/ /sangs rgyas kyis chos ston pa'i tshe/ gal te nam mkha' la 'phags na/ der rdzu 'phrul yod med gnyis ka'ang nam mkha' la 'phags te chos nyan par nus so/ /nyan thos de dag mya ngan las 'da' bar 'dod pa'i tshe/ cho 'phrul sna tshogs bstan nas mya ngan las 'da'o/ / nyon mongs dgra tshogs kun las rab rgyal te/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa rnam bzhi thob gyur pa'i/ /dgra bcom rnam thar brgyad la rab gnas pa/ /bgrang yas rnams kyis sangs rgyas zhing kun gang*/ /mi dge'i ltung ba dag la 'jug med phyir/ / ltung ba'i rnam par bzhag pa de na med/ /zas gos sogs kyang 'bad med 'byung ba'i phyir/ /bsod snyoms mi rgyur rtag tu skyid bder gnas/

/zhes bya ba ni/ nyan thos kyi yon tan brjod pa'i skabs so// //zhing de na byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor kyang grangs med cing dpag tu med la/ de dag kyang ye shes dang spob pa rgya mtsho lta bu ste chos kyi dbyings nam mkha' lta bu khong du chud cing rtogs pa ri rab ltar mtho ba'o/ /der sangs rgyas kyis chos ston pa ni/ bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyis chos ston pa las kyang rgya che la/ de 'dzin par byed pa sogs kyang de bzhin no/ /der ma zad byang sems de dag kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan nas gzhan du song ste chos nyan par byed cing*/ yang slar ldog par byed do/ /shi 'phos nas kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang du 'dod pa de dang der skye'o/ /de dag gis tshe gcig las ni/ bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong gi drung du bsod nams bsogs pa las kyang mang du sogs nus so/ / de dag ngan song lta shog/nyan thos dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sar yang mi ldog par bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu nges par sha stag go /de dag la bdud sdig can gyis bar chad byar mi nus la/ mi 'jigs pa thob cing bde ba dang ldan pa kho na yin no/ /byang chub sems dpa' grangs med pa de rnams kyi nang nas gtso bo ni gnyis te/ byang chub sems dpa' spos kyi glang po che zhes bya ba dang*/ bal glang spos kyi glang po zhes bya ba ste gnyis so/ /sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa de ni/ sku tshe bskal pa chen po 'bum phrag bcur gnas nas mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan pa'i 'og tu/ byang chub sems dpa' spos kyi glang po che zhing de nyid du 'tshang rgya'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi dam pa'i chos bskal pa chen po de tsam zhig phyis kyang gnas par 'gyur zhing*/ spos kyi glang po che'i zhing dang 'khor sogs kyang mi 'khrugs pa'i dus ji lta ba bzhin lhag chad med pa nyid du 'gyur ro/ /dri med rnam dag thugs bskyed brtan po yis/

/dpag med sems can don phyir go bgos te/ /tshad med rgyal sras spyod pa'i mtshor rol ba/ /grangs med rgyal sras klu dbang tshogs rnams bsngags/ /mang mang sangs rgyas zhing gzhan rgyal ba'i drung*/ /yang yang byon nas legs bshad dam pa'i chos/ /zab zab gsan nus rgyal ba'i sras po kun/ /nges nges rdzogs byang las ni phyir mi ldog /zhes bya ba ni/ byang chub sems dpa'i yon tan brjod pa'i skabs so// //zhing der skye ba'i rgyu ni/ sngon byang chub sems dpa' mi 'khrugs pas byang chub kyi phyir spyod pa ji ltar spyad pa de ltar spyad par bya'o snyam zhing smon lam 'debs na der skye zhing*/ gzhan yang rang phyin drug gang la spyod pa de'i dge ba sogs dge ba ci byas pa de dag thams cad/ mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing du skyes te sems can gyi don byas nas sangs rgyas thob par smon cing bsngos na/ der skye'o/ /gzhan yang*/ zhing gi yon tan dran pa dang*/ mi 'khrugs pa'i zhal mthong bar 'dod pa dang*/ /de dang 'grogs par 'dod pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi 'khor gyi grangs dang yon tan dran pa dang*/ mi 'khrugs pa'i mtshan nas brjod cing phyag 'tshal ba dang*/ sku bzhengs pa dang*/ mchod pa sogs dang*/ sras kyi mthu bo rnam pa gnyis kyi mtshan nas brjod cing*/ der skye ba'i smon lam 'debs pa dang*/ gzhan la'ang de ltar byed pas bskul na zhing der skye la/ mdor na/ zhing der skyes nas sems can thams cad la phan gdags par bya'o snyan na/ der skye bar 'gyur te/ rgyu'i gtso bo yin no/ /zhing der skye bar 'dod pa de dag 'chi ba'i dus kyi tshe sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pa dge 'dun gyi tshogs rnams rjes su dran cing smon na/ de dag kyang de'i drung du byon nas mthong bar 'gyur zhing*/ yid dga' bzhin du 'chi ba'i dus byas nas zhing der skye bar 'gyur bar gsungs so/ /gzhan yang*/ mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing bkod nas 'byung ba'i don gyi gtso bo gong du brjod pa de rnams rang gis shes shing bzung nas/

gzhan dag tshul de la 'jug par byed na/ sangs rgyas mi 'khrugs pas dgongs par 'gyur zhing*/ zhing der skye'o/ /de ltar byed rgyu 'byung ba ni/ sangs rgyas de nyid kyi mthu dang*/ sngon gyi smon lam gyi stobs ma gtogs gzhan du mi 'byung bar bshad la/ zhing bkod kyi khyad par brjod pa de dag rang gis shes shing gzhan la ston par byed pa la phan yon dpag tu med pa zhig gsungs pa rnams kyang shes par bya'o/ /der skye ba'i smon lam ni/ bdag gis zur du brjod zin pa ltar ro/ /zhes bya ba ni/ zhing de nyid du skye ba'i rgyu brjod pa'i skabs so/ /gang zhig rtse gcig gus pa'i yid kyis ni/ /gang gi mtshan bzung mchod bstod gsol 'debs pa/ /gang dag zhing der skye ba'i rgyu yi tshogs/ gang yin bshad rnams bsgrub pa gnad du che/ /mi 'khrugs rgyal ba'i mtshan tsam 'dzin byed na/ ngan 'gro las grol mngon dga'i zhing mchog der/ /skye bar nus par 'gyur na su zhig gis/ /rgyu tshogs 'di ltar bsgrubs tshe ci zhig smros/ /zhes bya'o// //yang bdag cag gi ston pa de nyid kyis/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi bsngags pa gzhan 'ga' re gsungs kyang*/ khyad par du bde ba can dang*/ mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing gnyis la bsngags pa rgya cher mdzad pa ni/ zhing 'di'i mi rnams phal cher der skye nus pa sogs kyi dgos pa khyad par can gzigs nas yin la/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing gzhan 'ga' zhig tu skyes kyang*/ slar ngan 'gror ldog srid pa dang*/ 'ga' zhig tu skye ba ni shin du dka' ba yin no/ /bsngags tshul ni/ mdo gzhan las gsungs pa yang mthong mod/ mtshon tsam ni/ thar pa chen po'i mdo las/ ngas ni mi 'khrugs 'jig rten dang*/ bde ba can gyi 'jig rten khams/ /shin tu rnam dag mthong ba na/ sdug bsngal bya ba'i ming yang med/ ces 'byung ba ltar ro/ /smras pa/ gting mtha' mi mngon rgya mtsho chen po'i dbus/ /rin chen in+d+ra nī la'i ri bo bzhin/

/rnam mang 'khor tshogs dbus na gang gi sku/ /lham mer rab gsal rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa/ /gang gis gus pas phyogs 'di na/ /na bzhin khyod kyi zhing bkod tshul/ /tshul dang mthun par brjod pa'i mi/ /mi 'dod kun las thar bar mdzod/ /bzang bzang rgyal ba'i dbang po khyod kyis ni/ /ngan ngan sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las bsgral te/ /brtan brtan bla med byang chub bde ba'i sar/ /mang mang sems can kun kyang 'khrid par mdzod/ /tshul 'dir tshul bzhin sgo gsum 'bad pa las/ /rnam dkar rnam mang gang zhig thob de yang*/ skye dang skye bar dal ba'i rten thob nas/ /myur bar myur du sangs rgyas thob phyir bsngo/ /ces rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing bkod kyi mdo las 'byung ba'i don bsdus te bstan pa 'di ni/ mdo sngags dang man ngag gi gnad kun mkhyen cing*/ lhag pa'i lha nye bar bsnyen pa'i nus pa'ang thob pas/ mkhas shing grub pa'i gnas su bgrang bar 'os pa/ shākya'i dge slong rgyal mtshan dpal bzang gi bkas bskul ba la brten nas/ co ne'i mtshan nyid kyi bla ma'i go sar gnas pa rab 'byams smra ba grags pa bshad sgrub kyis myur bar sbyar ba'o/ /bkra shis// //
mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa'i zhing la rnam par lta bar byed pa zhing mchog bgrod pa'i them skas bzhugs/ -PAGE 80--PAGE 81--PAGE 70-
